findings.summary: Building a schema throws when a role binds an assignment scope that is not configurable, so that panel produces no schema.
findings.failure_scenario: ScopeWorld's default panel registers StoreScope (AssignmentScopeDefinition only) and ReaderRole::scopes() returns StoreScope::class. RoleCompiler accepts it because ScopeConfiguration::filters() returns immediately for a non-configurable definition. SchemaBuilder::binding() sets $settings to null and then evaluates $settings->label. PHP warns, and Laravel HandleExceptions (error_reporting includes E_WARNING) throws ErrorException, so for() never returns a PanelSchema. ExternalProjectScope fails the same way.
findings.suggested_fix: Use $settings?->label ?? self::scopeLabel($registered), the same null-safe read already used for directory.

findings.summary: Model exists rules name the Eloquent class and, when the field is multiple, apply to the array, so they reject ids GrantFields accepts on the model table.
findings.failure_scenario: Field::model('department_id', Department::class) uses connection testbench, table departments, key id. FieldSchema::of() emits ['nullable', 'exists:AzGuard\Tests\Fixtures\Storage\Department,id']. GrantFields::typeRule() emits Rule::exists('testbench.departments', 'id'). Id 1 stored in departments passes GrantFields::validate and fails a validator built from the schema rules. Field::model(...)->multiple() with [1] passes GrantFields on department_id.* and fails the schema rule because exists is attached to the array. SchemaValuesTest asserts the class-based string, so the suite stays green.
findings.suggested_fix: In Schema, build the model rule from the model's connection, table and key as GrantFields::typeRule does, and for a multiple field describe the per-element rule instead of exists on the array.

checked: Dynamic overlay is one permissions() call per source with description.dynamic, scoped to the passed tenant; a global tenant on a tenant panel stays static
Policy authority forces sources=[] and contextTypes=[]; RoleSchema editable is always false and is not a constructor argument
decidedBy is policy:Class@method or gate:ability from catalog bindings; owner is the static snapshot source id or the dynamic source id
sources match the logged rule: ProvidesGrants always, role grants when a covering code role exists, folder only for GrantedToAll or a covering automatic role
Subject guard and directory come from the compiled SubjectDescriptor through DirectoryResolver, including configured classes and the P5.8 defaults
Schema toArray/jsonSerialize stay scalar; plugin closure secrets and source constructor passwords are not copied into SourceDescription or the JSON
Schema does not import Storage, Changes, or StoresGrants; schema values are final readonly; SchemaBuilder is @internal

Feature tests cover V72 authority/roles/fields, V104 tenant overlay and one permissions read, R24 filter class list, R38 badge plus writer refusal, and R49 snapshot and secret absence; they never build a schema for a non-configurable scope and they lock the class-based exists string

F1.evidence: ScopeWorld panel with non-configurable StoreScope bound by ReaderRole builds a schema; binding label falls back to 'store'. `$settings->label ?? x` with $settings=null raises no warning: ?? has isset semantics over the whole chain (PHPStan nullsafe.neverNull confirms). Coverage gap closed by a regression test.

F2.evidence: Laravel exists rule resolves a model class to its connection and table (testbench.departments): id 1 passes, id 9 fails, as Rule::exists in GrantFields; for a multiple field exists on the array checks every element via whereIn ([1] passes, [1,9] fails). Regression test compares schema rules with GrantFields-shaped rules.

outcome: no product correction; regression tests added for both reviewed paths
